misprints.note: Full stop printed where a comma is expected before the termination number.
No iota subscript is visible in the print (ἐπέτρεψαν αὐτῶ τοὺς παῖδας).
Kept as printed. Only listed so the reading is checked; not a clear error.

uncertain.note: The print has a raised dot after 2 (2·), probably a displaced full stop. Transcribed as '2.'.
The breathing glyph on αἱ looks like the rough breathing on ὁ/ἡ and was read as αἱ, not αἵ.
The genitive ending shows an acute only and no breathing. Transcribed as ίδος.
